target_audience: Adventure seekers, trekking enthusiasts, and tourists looking to explore Nepal's Himalayas

seo.title: Summit Nepal Trekking - Best Trekking Agency in Nepal
seo.description: Experience the adventure of a lifetime with Summit Nepal Trekking. Guided treks to Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, and more. Professional guides, safe journeys, unforgettable memories.

sections.title: Discover the Magic of the Himalayas
sections.subtitle: Adventure Awaits at Every Step
sections.description: Join us for unforgettable trekking experiences in Nepal. From the majestic Everest to the beautiful Annapurna, we make your Himalayan dreams come true.

sections.title: Who We Are
sections.description: Summit Nepal Trekking has been operating since 2012 with a mission to provide safe, enjoyable, and memorable trekking experiences in the Himalayas. Our team consists of certified mountain guides, experienced porters, and dedicated support staff who ensure your journey is safe and comfortable.

items.name: Everest Base Camp Trek
items.description: Journey to the base of the world's highest peak. 14-day adventure through Sherpa villages and stunning mountain views

items.name: Annapurna Circuit Trek
items.description: Experience the classic trek around Annapurna massif. 21 days of diverse landscapes and cultures

items.name: Annapurna Base Camp
items.description: Trek to the heart of the Annapurna sanctuary. 12 days of breathtaking mountain scenery

items.name: Langtang Valley Trek
items.description: Explore the beautiful Langtang region. 10 days close to Tibet with stunning views

items.name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
items.description: Trek around the 8th highest mountain in the world. Remote and less crowded

items.name: Custom Treks
items.description: Design your own adventure. We tailor treks to your preferences and fitness level

items.title: Certified Guides
items.description: Our guides are trained and certified by the Nepal Mountaineering Association

items.title: Safety First
items.description: Comprehensive safety measures including emergency evacuation support

items.title: Small Groups
items.description: Maximum 12 trekkers per group for personalized attention

items.title: Local Expertise
items.description: Deep knowledge of routes, culture, and mountain conditions
